newsitem.title: USA: Maverick Tube energy product shipments up.
newsitem.headline: Maverick Tube energy product shipments up.

text.p: Maverick Tube Corp said Monday that energy-related product shipments in the fourth quarter ended September 30 increased by 40 percent compared with a year ago.
Fourth quarter shipments of industrial products increased by 21 percent compared to the same quarter last year.
Earlier, Maverick Tube reported a fourth quarter profit of $0.38 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.19 a share. For fisal 1996, it earned $1.01 a share, up from a year-ago loss of $0.31.

"Maverick's increase in energy sales was due largely to the increase in natural gas drilling, improved efficiencies in oil-field technology and lower import competition," Gregg Eisenberg, president, said in a statement. "In addition, Maverick's product mix of energy related products has continued to shift toward higher margin products."
